text: The purpose of this report is to establish the 2020 meeting schedule for Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund. Four meeting dates are proposed for 2020. The date in April would be TAF’s Annual General Meeting.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved the following 2020 Board meeting dates: Friday, February 14, 2020 at 9:00 a.m. Tuesday, April 28, 2020 at 9:00 a.m. Thursday, July 16, 2020 at 9:00 a.m. Friday, November 6, 2020 at 9:00 a.m.
